verdict.rationale: The evidence describes automation that dispositions alerts and moves cases between agents and the team, plus a general automatic audit trail. Nothing documents a way to inspect an automated remediation decision, override it, and keep its original evidence and rationale. The audit trail and marketing language about defensible decisions are adjacent, not this capability.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can inspect and override an automated remediation decision while preserving its original evidence and rationale
